purpose: Commit the ruling's NA-1 amendment and verify the frozen contract it amends is untouched.
commit_sha_note: This receipt is staged inside the commit it describes, so it cannot contain that commit's own sha. The dispatching session records it in the queue's archive_binding, where research_dispatch.py verifies it.
binding_mode_note: content_first: the amendment is write-once and nothing reranks it, so binding its hash against HEAD is the stricter choice and catches a later in-place edit to a filed record. The goal head is not staged here, which is why this archive does not need the content_at_commit mode the ledger archive TASK-20260916-d4fb62 declared.

the_source_artifact_was_ALREADY_COMMITTE.what: AMD-EXP-SEMBIN-4fa22c-20260921-lemma4.yaml was landed at commit 852a3c5d2f5dad3c120df4ca81fd9100cd1b4635 (2026-09-21 18:30:45 +0000) by tools/producer_landing.py, in the turn its producer returned. So this commit stages only its own receipt.
the_source_artifact_was_ALREADY_COMMITTE.why: It is the CORR-20260921-942a62 remedy. The gap between production and archival is what destroyed this round's first attempt: a producer's output sat as an unowned working-tree artifact and the machine went away with it. producer_landing.py closes that gap by committing the declared set immediately, which necessarily inverts the historical order in which an archive created the files it bound.
the_source_artifact_was_ALREADY_COMMITTE.cost_stated_plainly: This commit is no longer where a later reader learns when the amendment first existed. A reader reconstructing the timeline must read the landing commit 852a3c5d2 instead. Same disclosure as TASK-20260916-92128f's receipt makes for the reader packages.
the_source_artifact_was_ALREADY_COMMITTE.the_binding_is_unaffected: content_first verifies a declared hash against the tree rather than against a changed-path set, so it holds identically whether the artifact was created by this commit or before it. A mismatch would still be fatal.

what_the_amendment_records.clause_L_1: S-5's phrase 'Lemma 4's inside form, which is UNPROVEN' is, at the contract's own declared equality convention, REFUTED as a universal statement, citing EV-SEMBIN-1ca3c8, with both witnesses and the 23.5% violation rate, both refuted placements named on the TRUE side, the '>=' scope note, and the inertness consequence that 'inside form' names no weaker fallback target because on the FAKE side the two forms are one statement.
what_the_amendment_records.clause_L_2: The operative clause: six numbered per-instance U-4 bookkeeping requirements. For every reported d'_F the run records the realising fake witness as a multiplier tuple and each UNREDUCED deg(g_i f_i) computed in F_2[X_1..X_N] before the Boolean identification, their max, and the per-instance verdict. Only where max_i deg(g_i f_i) <= d'_F holds may the report state the d_F <= d'_F consequence, and then as discharged by that bookkeeping rather than by citing Lemma 4. It also fixes what may NOT be concluded in the censored and failing cases, including that a failure is not to be read as d_F > d'_F, since U-4 is only sufficient.
what_the_amendment_records.clause_L_3: The 2015/310 citation anchor J-4a found absent from every record of this campaign, which had identified the consumed statement only by paraphrase inside a mechanism field: frozen path with sha256, section 4.5 line range, the route through Nagao, three unresolved candidate statements, provenance retrieved, verified_by TASK-20260916-64a93b, plus the LINK 1 characterisation qualification that Semaev states the result under the TRUE definition while his argument computes the FAKE bound.
what_the_amendment_records.clause_L_4: C-6 recorded as structurally uninformative for d'_F, because both placements it varies are on the FAKE side and inertness forces agreement. The control is NOT removed and is still run and reported; its outcome is labelled structurally forced rather than counted as a passed check.

two_findings_the_producer_returned_that_.T_1_adjudicated_and_the_decision_correct: The amendment's recorded_tension T-1 observed that DEC-20260916-87fc5c's third limitation concedes the refutation to the literal '>=' reading without qualification, while the Nagao reader's table at read-nagao-2013-549/report.md :389-395 shows witness A refuted under BOTH readings with S_fe OUTSIDE the true system. The producer declined to adjudicate, which was correct for a task holding no such decision. The dispatching session then confirmed it independently with tools/lemma4_inside_form.py for BOTH witnesses and by hand for the load-bearing cell, and recorded CORR-20260921-896b22: the '>=' void covers the inside-the-true-system placement only. The amendment is NOT edited; its caution is vindicated rather than overridden, and L-1 remains historically accurate for the limitation it was directed to quote.
two_findings_the_producer_returned_that_.S_1_residual_defect_left_unrepaired: S-1's criterion text gives as its reason 'because Lemma 4 runs d_F <= d'_F', so a run satisfying S-1 as frozen will print a reason invoking a premise L-1 records as refuted. The producer's first draft forbade citing Lemma 4 as a theorem anywhere, which would have put the amendment in direct contradiction with a frozen success criterion -- an executor could only have resolved that by treating the amendment as overriding the contract, which is a rewrite by another route. It scoped the prohibition to the consequence statements L-2 governs and added what_requirement_5_does_NOT_reach saying so. The defect stands, stated plainly rather than repaired. NA-1 directs nothing about S-1 and changing it needs its own decision.
two_findings_the_producer_returned_that_.why_both_are_in_this_receipt: Neither is a property of this commit, and both are properties of the record this commit makes durable. A receipt that lists only what it staged loses the two things about the staged record a later reader most needs.

what_this_archive_does_not_do: It does not change EXP-SEMBIN-4fa22c's status, which stays `approved` and unrun.
It does not approve or dispatch a run, and adds, removes or resizes no arm, budget or stopping rule.
It does not promote the claim. review-breakthrough at max remains undegradable and unservable here, and IMP-SEMBIN-FCB7A2-LEMMA4-TIER stands.
It asserts nothing about Nagao's Proposition 5, Semaev's Assumption 1, any value of d_F4, any elliptic curve, or the security of any deployed parameter set.
It does not assume that the EQS4 instances this contract will measure are among the violating instances. That is precisely why L-2 is a per-instance requirement.
It does not edit the frozen specification, the read plan, the opening report, either checkpoint, either reader's package, or any earlier amendment.
It does not close the round's independence gate, which stands NOT SATISFIED with two permanent deviations.
